framework: local VectorBT 1.2.0, cached native parent fills and identical native handling for new fills
other_inputs: data/research/monday_breadth_optimization_20261108 for native policy fills, local quoted prices and historical Binance USD-M funding
interpretation: Initial and follow-up bars were closed by the last 2026-10-27 UTC research candle. Previously inspected 2026 market history is a retrospective comparison. The September example motivated the target.

2026 rows use actual funding when available, 0.05% per market fill or 0.02% per profit limit fill, 1x without modeled slippage, separate 0.20 percentage-point round-trip sensitivity. On older assets some realized rates are valued at the archived mark candle open.

Growth compounds each sleeve independently as if all its unlevered capital is deployed. Equal sleeves initially split 50/50 with no rebalancing. Portfolio risk marks use synchronized five-minute closes and realized settlements. Single closed-trade and before-funding drawdowns use separate headings in the source files.

Six single-account pairs and the BTC-specific exit family include all frozen variations; do not pool p-values across repeated variants. The equal-sleeve paired test compares each sleeve's mean matched event with an equal-weighted mean across sleeves on a fees-only basis. Unmatched periods receive no imputed return. It does not reconstruct a tradable random portfolio.

A single calendar-year row resets initial weights on January 1 for comparison. The three development periods are 2020-2022, 2023-2024 and 2025. Fixed-time original schedules purge trades overlapping these period cutoffs. Forks using a later exit apply their own boundary check.

The post-hoc integrated overlay keeps rare BTC entries independent of the below-EMA filter, which vetoes ordinary BTC bookings only after original source reservations. 75% deployment is relative to current equity of each sleeve per signal; each idle quarter holds cash. Prior-window membership is unchanged. The historical risk reconstruction of the two sleeves is matched at every 5-minute close, excluding historical ALT funding. The 2026 mark includes funding on held legs.

Original six-hour baskets also reconcile for all 25/25 2026 events. Thirteen formerly flagged constituent rows were independently reconciled to the interval recorded in each Binance monthly fundingRate archive.
